description: This Java source file defines the class 'DbModeSimulationRunner', which simulates database on/off scenarios for the OrangeHRM test suite. It runs multiple simulations, collects results, and generates a comprehensive markdown report analyzing the behavior, stability, and issues related to environment classification and test dependencies.

classes.name: DbModeSimulationRunner
classes.description: Main class responsible for simulating database-on and database-off scenarios, executing multiple test runs, collecting results, and generating a detailed markdown report analyzing environment classification, stability, issues, and behavioral differences.

methods.name: runFullSimulation
methods.description: Runs the full set of simulations for DB-ON and DB-OFF modes and returns a comprehensive markdown report.

methods.name: executeSimulationRun
methods.description: Performs a single simulation run, setting environment properties, invoking environment classification, measuring duration, and capturing results and errors.

methods.name: generateReport
methods.description: Generates a detailed markdown report analyzing all simulation runs, stability, issues, dependencies, and behavioral differences between modes.

methods.name: formatRunRow
methods.description: Formats a single run's summary as a markdown table row.

methods.name: formatRunDetails
methods.description: Formats detailed information about a specific simulation run for inclusion in the report.

methods.name: checkConsistency
methods.description: Checks whether all runs of a mode have the same environment classification state.
